module_summary: Open-aperture surface suite exposing signature, operators, drift surface, and lineage hooks for all Open* domains. Not to be confused with the OpenAPI Specification (OAS/Swagger) REST-schema standard.
author: Nawder Loswin

files.description: Suite root index. Navigation hub for all Open* surface modules.
HTML front door for the openapi suite with canonical head block.
Developer-facing README. Setup, navigation, and contribution guide.
OpenLLM consolidated surface: architecture, canonical metadata, governance, operators, openapi loop, three rings, drift-event JSON, worked example.
OpenIAM consolidated surface: identity, access chain, principal registry, operators, openapi loop, three rings, worked example.
OpenRisk consolidated surface: risk tier definitions, severity formula, gate protocol, operators, openapi loop, three rings.
OpenGeo consolidated surface: geospatial and temporal grounding, coordinate anchors, location scope levels, operators, openapi loop.
OpenGPU consolidated surface: parallel execution substrate, execution modes, throughput regimes, gate protocol, operators.
OpenData consolidated surface: data surface, lineage registry, schema registry, lineage note schema, operators, lineage store structure.
Per-module manifest listing all files, roles, and analyzer layers for this suite.
Cross-suite registry of all Open* modules with IDs, versions, and signature summaries.
Quad map: four-quadrant view of the suite by ring and regime.
Suite navigation structure for site nav and AI agent traversal.
XML sitemap for the openapi suite for search engines and AI crawlers.
